references.title: IRAS, Tax clearance for employees, "When There is Additional Income Payable to Your Employee" (read
references.quote: IRAS, Tax clearance for employees, "When There is Additional Income Payable to Your Employee" (read 2026-10-07): file an Additional/Amended Form IR21 to seek further tax clearance before releasing the additional income; do not report it in the next IR8A/AIS. IRAS, Getting tax clearance: a step-by-step guide, Step 5: after an Amended/Additional IR21 do not release the withheld monies until its Clearance Directive. Income Tax Act 1947 s.68(7). A payment after clearance is a slip of a period after the exit, or a slip after an earlier one in the exit period (an off-cycle run after the final pay). Ceiling: one recorded clearance releases every later payment. https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/individual-income-tax/employers/tax-clearance-for-foreign-spr-employees-(ir21)/tax-clearance-for-employees

references.title: Cleaning: Order by the Commissioner for Labour under Environmental Public Health Act 1987 s.80H(2),
references.quote: Cleaning: Order by the Commissioner for Labour under Environmental Public Health Act 1987 s.80H(2), para 1.5 (https://www.mom.gov.sg/-/media/mom/documents/employment-practices/pwm/order-by-commissioner-for-labour-under-section-80h2.pdf): a Citizen or SPR cleaner with 12 continuous months with the business at its cut-off date is paid at least two weeks of basic monthly wage (monthly basic × 12 ÷ 52 × 2) a year, once or twice a calendar year, in CPF-attracting bonuses. Landscape: Addendum to the Tripartite Cluster for Landscape Industry report on the PWM Bonus, 3 July 2019 (https://www.mom.gov.sg/-/media/mom/documents/employment-practices/pwm/addendum-to-tcl-report-progressive-wage-model-bonus---3-july-2019.pdf), an NParks Landscape Company Register condition: the same quantum and service. Read 2026-10-07. Checked on the last slip of the calendar year against the year’s bonus lines; the pro-rated leaver bonus (change of service provider, retirement, medical board-out) is HR’s.
